arxiv-1806-02765.title: Gravity as a Yang-Mills Theory Based on the Lorentz Group
arxiv-1806-02765.creator: Hans Christian Öttinger
arxiv-1806-02765.description: Abstract The Yang-Mills theory associated with the restricted Lorentz group is revisited as a candidate for a theory of gravity. This is a natural idea because the principle of equivalence of gravitation and inertia suggests to introduce locally inertial coordinate systems with the gauge freedom of Lorentz transformations.

arxiv-1809-06223.title: Unsupervised Sense-Aware Hypernymy Extraction
arxiv-1809-06223.creator: Dmitry Ustalov, Alexander Panchenko, Chris Biemann, Simone Paolo Ponzetto
arxiv-1809-06223.description: Abstract In this paper, we show how unsupervised sense representations can be used to improve hypernymy extraction. We present a method for extracting disambiguated hypernymy relationships that propagate hypernyms to sets of synonyms (synsets), constructs embeddings for these sets, and establishes sense-aware relationships between matching synsets.

arxiv-2107-09329.title: Simple security proof of coherent-one-way quantum key distribution
arxiv-2107-09329.creator: Rui-Qi Gao, Yuan-Mei Xie, Jie Gu, Wen-Bo Liu, Chen-Xun Weng, Bing-Hong Li, Hua-Lei Yin, Zeng-Bing Chen
arxiv-2107-09329.description: Abstract Coherent-one-way quantum key distribution (COW-QKD), which requires a simple experimental setup and has the ability to withstand photon-number-splitting attacks, has been not only experimentally implemented but also commercially applied. However, recent studies have shown that the current COW-QKD system is insecure and can only distribute secret keys safely within 20 km of the optical fiber length.

arxiv-2109-08302.title: Rack-Aware MSR Codes with Multiple Erasure Tolerance
arxiv-2109-08302.creator: Jiaojiao Wang, Dabin Zheng, Shenghua Li
arxiv-2109-08302.description: Abstract The minimum storage rack-aware regenerating (MSRR) code is a variation of regenerating codes that achieves the optimal repair bandwidth for a single node failure in the rack-aware model. The authors in [ 1 ] and [ 25 ] provided explicit constructions of MSRR codes for all parameters to repair a single failed node.

arxiv-2203-08866.title: Non-minimal non-Abelian quantum vector fields in curved spacetime
arxiv-2203-08866.creator: L. L. Salcedo
arxiv-2203-08866.description: Abstract The quantum effective action of non-minimal vector fields with Abelian or non-Abelian gauge degrees of freedom in curved spacetime is studied. The Proca or Yang-Mills fields are coupled to a local mass-like term acting in both coordinate and gauge spaces.

arxiv-2411-11126.title: Identifying good forecasters via adaptive cognitive tests
arxiv-2411-11126.description: Abstract Assessing forecasting proficiency is a time-intensive activity, often requiring us to wait months or years before we know whether or not the reported forecasts were good. In this study, we develop adaptive cognitive tests that predict forecasting proficiency without the need to wait for forecast outcomes.

arxiv-2506-07326.description: Abstract . Reward modeling has emerged as a crucial component in aligning large language models with human values. Significant attention has focused on using reward models as a means for fine-tuning generative models. However, the reward models themselves—which directly encode human value judgments by turning prompt-response pairs into scalar rewards—remain relatively understudied.

pmc-10497580.creator: Sha Song, Xianjue Ma
pmc-10497580.description: The Hippo pathway is a master regulator of organ growth, stem cell renewal, and tumorigenesis, its activation is tightly controlled by various post-translational modifications, including ubiquitination. pmc-10516687.title: The prevalence of chronic dehydration and associated with cardiometabolic risks among agriculture and aquaculture workers
pmc-10516687.creator: Ta-Chin Wang, Yuan-Hsiung Tsai, Jen-Tsung Yang, Ming-Shyang Lin, Yu-Chih Lin, Tung-Jung Huang, Mei-Yen Chen
pmc-10516687.description: BackgroundChronic dehydration is associated with complications and mortality in acute ischemic stroke patients. Prior literature indicates that farmers and fishery workers are commonly affected by cardiometabolic diseases and there is a need for early prevention of stroke. This study explores the prevalence of dehydration and the association of cardiometabolic risk profiles in agricultural and aquaculture workers.

ObjectivesTo evaluate the accuracy and reproducibility of real time ultrasound (US) steatometry with the Attenuation Coefficient (AC) measurement in comparison with magnetic resonance imaging with proton density software module (MRI-PDFF).MethodsThis study was conducted between January 2021 and October 2021. The comparison of instrumental methods for assessing and grading hepatic steatosis using a multimodal phantom simulator of different fat and water ratios was performed. The study involved 3 radiological centers.

pmc-11647289.description: AbstractIntroductionWith the development of the medical system and the diversification of patient needs, nurse practitioners (NPs) play an increasingly important role in medical practice, assuming more responsibilities and powers, including the right to prescribe. However, in the process of exercising the right to prescribe, NPs may face various obstacles, and there are also some promoting factors.

Many health care professionals feel uncomfortable and insecure in conducting intentional sedation due to specific challenges.

pmc-12801804.title: Feasibility of a compulsory online compassion training module in final year medical student curriculum
pmc-12801804.creator: P Didaskalu, C Barton, D Ling, J Harrison, M Leech, C Hassed
pmc-12801804.description: BackgroundPsychological distress among medical students and junior doctors is a significant concern, with burnout and mental health issues being common. Compassion training has shown promise in improving psychological well-being among healthcare workers, including medical students, and has been shown to mitigate empathic distress and burnout.

pmc-13017378.title: Impaired awareness of hypoglycemia: can structured education address this persistent challenge?
pmc-13017378.creator: Yuanyuan Chen, Xiaowen He, Yanmin Shan, Meijuan Lan
pmc-13017378.description: Impaired Awareness of Hypoglycemia (IAH) describes a condition in insulin-treated diabetic patients characterized by a diminished ability to perceive the onset of acute hypoglycemia. With an estimated prevalence ranging from 23.2% to 26.3%, IAH is associated with a significantly elevated risk of severe hypoglycemia (SH) and is increasingly linked to emotional disturbances.

pmc-13073901.title: Munropins G–J: Four New Prieurianin-Type Limonoids from Munronia pinnata and Their Structural and Molecular Characterization

pmc-13073901.description: Munronia pinnata (Meliaceae), a medicinal plant used in Zhuang traditional medicine, is recognized as a rich source of structurally diverse limonoids. In our continuing investigation of bioactive constituents from Guangxi medicinal plants, four new prieurianin-type limonoids, munropins G–J (1–4), were isolated from their aerial parts.

pmc-13328720.creator: Adel Younesi
pmc-13328720.description: Given the importance of damage identification in structures, this research presents a laboratory modal data-based method. pmc-13371278.creator: Changmeng Wu, Wenhan Du, Weidong Chen, Juan He, Linlin Xu, Yu Li
pmc-13371278.description: BackgroundThe International Consensus on ANA Patterns (ICAP) recently codified the AC‐30 nuclear pattern, characterized by fine speckled nuclear texture and metaphase chromatin staining. Although formally recognized, its clinical significance remains unclear. Quantitative methods and objective outcome measures for characterizing AC‐30 have not been established.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted using archived HEp‐2 ANA images.

pmc-13628752.title: Inverse co-variation of circulating PIWIL2 and PIWIL4 in gastric adenocarcinoma: an exploratory ELISA-based study
pmc-13628752.creator: Mariam Abuladze, Elene Kekelia, Ian Alexander Cree, Eter Dumbadze, Ekaterina Kldiashvili
pmc-13628752.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundGastric cancer is characterized by substantial molecular heterogeneity, and RNA-mediated regulatory mechanisms may contribute to its biological complexity. PIWI-family proteins are central components of the PIWI-interacting RNA pathway, but their circulating patterns in gastric adenocarcinoma remain insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13676445.title: Baseline Symptom Collection in Elite Rugby Union Players—Limited Clinical Utility? An Investigation of Assessments Across 5879 men and Women Athletes
pmc-13676445.creator: James Brown, Ross Tucker, Christina Mack, Gordon Ward Fuller, Lindsay Starling, Martin Raftery, Éanna Cian Falvey
pmc-13676445.description: In World Rugby's Head Injury Assessment (HIA) protocol, a modified Sports Concussion Assessment Tool (SCAT) is completed during the pre‐season (baseline) and when a player has a suspected head injury. The symptom component of the SCAT, which involves comparing current to baseline symptoms, has been shown to be the most predictive component for concussion diagnosis.
